kpis.name: Turnovers
kpis.description: Number of turnovers by the team per match.

kpis.name: Turnover line height (m)
kpis.description: Mean height on the pitch in meters of the team's turnovers per match.

kpis.name: Recoveries within 5s %
kpis.description: Percentage of open play losses which were recovered by the team within 5 seconds per match.

kpis.name: Time to defensive action (s)
kpis.description: Median time that it took the team to make a defensive action following a turnover per match.

kpis.name: Time to recovery (s)
kpis.description: Median time that it took the team to recover the possession of the ball following a turnover per match.

kpis.name: Opp. Possessions to final third within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Number of possessions by the opponent with a final third entry within 10 seconds after a recovery from outside of the final third per match.
kpis.display_name: Opp. Possessions to final third within 10s after recovery

kpis.name: Opp. Possessions to box within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Number of possessions of the opponent with a box entry within 10 seconds after a recovery from outside of the box per match.
kpis.display_name: Opp. Possessions to box within 10s after recovery

kpis.name: Opp. xT within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Accumulated position-based expected threat of the opponent within 10 seconds after a recovery per match.

kpis.name: Opp. xG within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Accumulated expected goals of the opponent within 10 seconds after a recovery per match.
